card.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
card.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For tonight's moon audit, who signs the village's findings?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The oldest owl. I'm delivering them, but my shift ends at sunset.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can we get its signature before you finish?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It starts at moonrise. I'll stay, but you have to approve my overtime.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved. Put 'waiting for owl' on your timesheet. Who covers delivery if it's cloudy?
